findings.body: Off-by-one: `end = start + size - 1` combined with slice's exclusive end drops the last item on every page; use `start + size`.

hotspots.reason: Pagination slice end was changed to start + size - 1, an off-by-one that silently drops the last item per page.

testFlags.note: No test covers the page-boundary behavior (inferred, not measured).

evidence: src/lib/paginate.ts: changed slice end from start + size to start + size - 1, altering pagination results.
